text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
PrussianStateParliament(x) ::: x is the Prussian State Parliament.
NaziReichstag(x) ::: x is the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
German(heinrich) ∧ Politician(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
Member(heinrich, prussianStateParliament) ∧ Member(heinrich, naziReichstag) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
∃x (German(x) ∧ Politician(x) ∧ Member(x, prussianStateParliament) ∧ Member(x, naziReichstag)) ::: Some German politician was part of both the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
